applicant.name: Dr. Sophie Lechner
applicant.organisation: Danube Institute for Diabetes Research (university research group)

request.purpose: Scientific research on the epidemiology of chronic diseases to inform prevention programmes.
request.question: What fraction of adults with asthma currently uses a fixed-dose inhaler combination, by sex?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Asthma = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J45.
ICS/LABA inhaler = ATC code starting with R03AK.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per sex: adults with asthma and the percentage with an active ICS/LABA inhaler, one decimal.
